rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Resource Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products and Automobiles and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Resource Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products and Automobiles and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Energy Recovery Standards) The term “standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 2, Subparagraph 7 of the “Act on Resource Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products and Automobiles ” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)shall be as follows: <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Energy Recovery Standards) The standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment in Article 2, subparagraph 7 of the Act on Resource Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products and Automobiles (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall be as follows: <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. The energy recovery efficiency (referring to the ratio of the total recovered energy to the total input energy) must be 60 percent or higher.
rows.text_en: 1. The energy recovery efficiency (referring to the ratio of the total recovered energy to the total input energy) must be 60 percent or higher.

rows.source_ko: 2. Use all recovered heat as a heat source yourself or supply it to others.
rows.text_en: 2. Use all recovered heat as a heat source yourself or supply it to others.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Publication of Compliance with Restrictions on the Use of Hazardous Substances, etc.) When publishing whether there is compliance with the standards for the content of hazardous substances or the annual recyclability rate pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Resource Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products and Automobiles (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), it shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Publication of Compliance with Restrictions on the Use of Hazardous Substances, etc.) When publishing whether there is compliance with the standards for the content of hazardous substances or the annual recyclability rate pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Resource Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products and Automobiles (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), it shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 3. 회수ㆍ재활용 비용 지급명세 등 회수ㆍ재활용 실적 증명서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving collection and recycling performance, such as details of payment for collection and recycling costs

rows.source_ko: 4. 수탁자의 폐전기ㆍ폐전자제품 회수 근거지를 증명할 수 있는 서류(위탁하여 회수하는 경우에만 첨부하되, 배출자의 거주지를 직접 방문하여 회수하는 경우는 제외한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 4. One copy of documents proving the trustee's base of operations for the collection of waste electrical and electronic products (to be attached only when collection is entrusted, except in cases where collection is carried out by visiting the generator's residence directly).

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제18조제1항에 따라 전기ㆍ전자제품 판매업자 및 공제조합이 회수의무이행결과보고서를 제출할 때에는 별지 제5호의2서식의 회수의무이행결과보고서(전자문서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 공단에 제출하여야 한다. <신설 2012. 1. 3., 2013. 12. 31., 2015. 7. 20.>
rows.text_en: ② When electrical and electronic product retailers and mutual aid associations submit a report on the results of fulfilling the obligation to recover products pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , they shall submit it to the Corporation by attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents) to the report on the results of fulfilling the obligation to recover products (including electronic documents) in the form of Annex 5-2. <Newly added Jan. 3, 2012; Dec. 31, 2013; July 20, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 회수의무 대상 전기ㆍ전자제품의 회수관리대장 사본(회수를 위탁한 경우에는 수탁자의 전기ㆍ전자제품의 회수관리대장 사본) 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the recall management ledger for electrical and electronic products subject to recall obligations (or a copy of the trustee's electrical and electronic product recall management ledger in the case of entrusted recall).

rows.source_ko: 2. 회수 비용 지급명세 등 회수실적 증명서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving recovery performance, such as details of recovery cost payments

rows.source_ko: 3. 수탁자의 폐전기ㆍ폐전자제품 회수 근거지를 증명할 수 있는 서류(위탁하여 회수하는 경우에만 첨부하되, 배출자의 거주지를 직접 방문하여 회수하는 경우는 제외한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of documents proving the trustee's base of operations for the collection of waste electrical and electronic products (to be attached only when collection is entrusted, except in cases where collection is carried out by visiting the generator's residence directly).
[Title amended Jan. 3, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 납부고지) 영 제19조의2제3항 및 제20조의2제3항에 따른 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 납부고지는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다. <개정 2013. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Notice of Payment of Recycling Charges and Recovery Charges) The notice of payment of recycling charges and recovery charges pursuant to Article 19-2 , Paragraph 3 and Article 20-2 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form . <Amended Dec. 31, 2013>
[Title amended Dec. 31, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 분할납부) ① 영 제19조의2제3항 후단 및 제20조의2제3항 후단에 따라 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금을 분할납부할 수 있는 경우는 산출된 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금이 100만원 이상인 경우로 한정하고, 연 2회로 똑같이 나누어 내게 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Installment Payment of Recycling Charges and Recovery Charges) ① Pursuant to the latter part of Article 19-2 , Paragraph 3 and the latter part of Article 20-2 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, cases in which recycling charges and recovery charges may be paid in installments shall be limited to cases where the calculated recycling charges and recovery charges amount to 1 million won or more, and shall be paid in equal installments twice a year. <Amended Dec. 31, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제19조의2제4항 단서에 따른 재활용부과금 및 영 제20조의2제4항 단서에 따른 회수부과금의 납부기한은 1회분은 해당 연도 8월 31일까지로, 2회분은 해당 연도 11월 30일까지로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31., 2016. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The deadline for payment of the recycling charge pursuant to the proviso of Article 19-2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree and the recovery charge pursuant to the proviso of Article 20-2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be August 31 of the relevant year for the first installment and November 30 of the relevant year for the second installment. <Amended Dec. 31, 2013; Mar. 22, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금을 분할납부하려는 자는 별지 제5호의3서식의 분할납부신청서를 제8조에 따른 재활용 및 회수의무이행결과보고서를 제출할 때 함께 공단에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ Any person who intends to pay recycling charges and recovery charges in installments shall submit an application for installment payment in the form of Annex 5-3 to the Corporation together with the report on the results of fulfilling recycling and recovery obligations pursuant to Article 8. <Amended Dec. 31, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ④ 공단은 제3항에 따라 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 분할납부 신청을 받으면 제9조에 따른 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 납부고지를 갈음하여 해당 연도 7월 31일까지 별지 제6호서식에 따라 분할납부 고지를 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31., 2016. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: ④ Upon receiving an application for installment payment of recycling charges and recovery charges pursuant to Paragraph 3, the Corporation shall issue a notice of installment payment in accordance with Form No. 6 attached hereto by July 31 of the relevant year, in lieu of the notice of payment of recycling charges and recovery charges pursuant to Article 9. <Amended Dec. 31, 2013; Mar. 22, 2016>

[This Article newly established Nov. 1, 2012]
[Title amended Dec. 31, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제10조의2(재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 징수유예ㆍ분할납부의 신청절차 등) ① 영 제21조의3제3항에 따라 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 징수유예, 분할납부 또는 징수유예 기간 연장을 신청하려는 자는 별지 제7호서식의 부과금 징수유예ㆍ분할납부ㆍ징수유예 기간 연장 신청서를 공단에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10-2 (Application Procedures for Deferment of Collection and Installment Payment of Recycling Charges and Recovery Charges, etc.) ①who wishes to apply for deferment of collection, installment payment, or extension of the deferment period for recycling charges and recovery charges pursuant to Article 21-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the application for deferment of collection, installment payment, or extension of the deferment period for charges in the form of Annex 7 to the Corporation.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 공단은 그 내용을 검토하여 별지 제7호의2서식의 부과금 징수유예ㆍ분할납부ㆍ징수유예 기간 연장 결과 통지서를 신청인에게 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Corporation that receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall review the contents thereof and notify the applicant of the result of the deferment of collection, installment payment, or extension of the deferment period for collection of charges in the form of Annex 7-2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제21조의3제6항에 따른 징수유예ㆍ분할납부 결정의 취소 통지는 별지 제7호의3서식의 부과금 징수유예ㆍ분할납부 취소통지서로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The notice of cancellation of the decision on deferment of collection or installment payment pursuant to Article 21-3, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be the Notice of Cancellation of Deferment of Collection or Installment Payment of Levy in Form No. 7-3 of the Appendix .
[This Article Newly Inserted June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제10조의3(재활용부과금 및 회수부과금의 납부기한 전 징수) 공단은 법 제18조의5제4항에 따라 재활용부과금 및 회수부과금을 그 납부기한 전에 징수하려는 경우에는 같은 조 제5항에 따라 새로운 납부기한을 정하여 별지 제7호의4서식의 납부기한변경고지서로 고지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10-3 (Collection of Recycling Charges and Recovery Charges Before Payment Due Date) If the Corporationintends to collect recycling charges and recovery charges before payment due date pursuant to Article 18-5, Paragraph 4 of the Act , it shall set a new payment due date pursuant to Paragraph 5 of the same Article and notify the date using the Notice of Change of Payment Due Date in Form No. 7-4 of the Attached Form.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제10조의4(재활용부과금 및 회수부과금에 대한 이의신청 등) ① 영 제21조의5제1항에 따라 이의를 신청하려는 자는 별지 제7호의5서식의 부과금 이의신청서를 공단에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10-4 (Objection to Recycling Charges and Recovery Charges, etc.) ①Any person who wishes to file an objection pursuant to Article 21-5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an objection to the charges in the form of Annex 7-5 to the Corporation.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 공단은 신청 내용을 검토하여 그 처리 결과를 신청인에게 별지 제7호의6서식의 결정서로 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Corporation that receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall review the contents of the application and notify the applicant of the processing result using the decision form in Annex 7-6 .
[This Article Newly Inserted June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(폐전기ㆍ폐전자제품의 재활용촉진에 대한 재정적 지원) ① 법 제20조제2항 및 제3항에 따른 지원 대상 사업자 및 부과금 감경기준은 별표 2의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Financial Support for the Promotion of Recycling of Waste Electrical and Electronic Products) ①The business operators eligible for support and the criteria for reduction of levies pursuant to Article 20 , Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Act are as set forth in Table 2-2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 부과금 감경신청 및 감경절차 등 부과금 감경에 관하여 필요한 사항은 기후에너지환경부장관이 정하여 고시하는 바에 따른다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Matters necessary for the reduction of levies, such as applications for reduction and reduction procedures, shall be determined and notified by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted July 20, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의2
rows.text_en: Article 11-2
[Article 11-2 moved to Article 5-2 <December 31, 2013>]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의3(미래폐자원 거점수거센터의 운영) ① 공단은 매년 12월 15일까지 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함한 다음 연도의 미래폐자원 거점수거센터의 운영계획서를 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 11-3 (Operation of Future Waste Resource Hub Collection Centers) ① The Corporation shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by December 15 of each year an operation plan for the Future Waste Resource Hub Collection Centers for the following year, including the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제20조의4제2항 각 호의 업무 수행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the performance of duties under each subparagraph of Article 20-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1호에 따른 업무 수행에 필요한 예산명세
rows.text_en: 2. Budget details necessary for the performance of duties pursuant to Item 1

rows.source_ko: ② 공단은 매년 1월 31일까지 전년도의 미래폐자원 거점수거센터의 운영결과를 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Corporation shall submit the results of the operation of the Future Waste Resource Hub Collection Centers for the previous year to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by January 31 of each year. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 미래폐자원 거점수거센터의 운영에 필요한 사항은 공단의 업무규정으로 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters stipulated in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the operation of future waste resource hub collection centers shall be determined by the Corporation's operational regulations.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(공제조합 설립의 인가 절차 등) ① 법 제22조에 따라 공제조합 설립의 인가를 받으려는 자는 별지 제8호서식의 재활용사업공제조합 설립인가신청서(전자문서를 포함한다)에 법 제22조제1항 각 호의 사항이 포함된 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Procedures for Approval of Establishment of Mutual Aid Association, etc.) ①person who intends to obtain approval for the establishment of a mutual aid association pursuant to Article 22 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for approval of the establishment of a recycling business mutual aid association (including electronic documents) in the form of Annex No. 8 , attached with documents (including electronic documents) containing the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 22 , Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Amended Dec. 31, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 기후에너지환경부장관은 제1항에 따라 공제조합의 설립인가신청을 받으면 다음 각 호의 사항을 검토하여 적합한 경우 이를 인가하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application for approval of the establishment of a mutual aid association pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall review the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs and, if deemed appropriate, grant approval. <Amended Dec. 31, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 목적과 사업이 타당하고 실현 가능한지 여부
rows.text_en: 1. Whether the purpose and project are valid and feasible

rows.source_ko: 2. 재활용사업을 지속적으로 수행할 수 있도록 적정한 조합원수와 재활용의무량 또는 회수의무량을 확보하고 있는지 여부
rows.text_en: 2. Whether an appropriate number of members and mandatory recycling or recovery quotas have been secured to continuously carry out the recycling business

rows.source_ko: 3. 재활용사업을 지속적으로 수행할 수 있는 재정능력을 갖추고 있는지 여부
rows.text_en: 3. Whether it possesses the financial capacity to continuously carry out the recycling business

rows.source_ko: 4. 다른 공제조합과 명칭이 구별되는지 여부
rows.text_en: 4. Whether the name is distinguishable from other mutual aid associations

rows.source_ko: ③ 기후에너지환경부장관은 제1항에 따라 공제조합 설립인가신청을 받은 때에는 특별한 사유가 없으면 30일 이내에 제2항에 따라 검토하여 인가 여부를 결정하고 서면으로 신청인에게 알려야 한다. 이 경우 인가를 할 때에는 별지 제9호서식의 재활용사업공제조합 설립인가증을 신청인에게 발급하고 별지 제10호서식의 재활용사업공제조합 설립인가대장에 필요한 사항을 적어야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment receives an application for approval of the establishment of a mutual aid association pursuant to Paragraph 1, unless there are special circumstances, the Minister shall review the application pursuant to Paragraph 2 within 30 days to determine whether to grant approval and notify the applicant in writing. In this case, when granting approval, the Minister shall issue a Certificate of Approval for the Establishment of a Recycling Business Mutual Aid Association in the form of Annex 9 to the applicant and record the necessary matters in the Register of Approval for the Establishment of a Recycling Business Mutual Aid Association in the form of Annex 10. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 기후에너지환경부장관은 제2항에 따른 공제조합의 설립인가의 검토를 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 신청인에게 기간을 정하여 필요한 서류를 제출하게 하거나 설명을 요구할 수 있다. 이 경우 그에 걸리는 기간은 제3항의 기간에 산입되지 아니한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ If the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems it necessary for the review of the approval of the establishment of a mutual aid association pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister may set a period and require the applicant to submit necessary documents or provide explanations. In this case, the period required therefor shall not be included in the period under Paragraph 3. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제22조제4항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각호와 같다. <개정 2015. 7. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The terms “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 22, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended July 20, 2015; October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 명칭
rows.text_en: 2. Name

rows.source_ko: 3. 사무소 소재지
rows.text_en: 3. Location of the office

rows.source_ko: 4. 자체 재활용시설의 내용(자체 재활용시설을 가지고 있는 공제조합에만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Details of in-house recycling facilities (Applicable only to cooperative associations with in-house recycling facilities)

rows.source_ko: 제12조의2(인가의 취소) 법 제22조의3제4호에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 경우”란 1년간 3회 이상 시정명령을 받고도 이를 시정하지 아니한 경우를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 12-2 (Cancellation of Authorization) In subparagraph 4 of Article 22-3 of the Act , the phrase “cases prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to cases where corrective orders have been received three or more times within a one-year period but have not been rectified. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted July 20, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(사업자단체의 설립인가절차 등) ① 법 제30조에 따라 사업자단체 설립인가를 받으려는 자는 별지 제11호서식의 폐자동차재활용사업자단체 설립인가신청서(전자문서를 포함한다)에 영 제28조제1항 각 호의 사항이 포함된 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Procedures for Approval of Establishment of Business Associations, etc.) ① Any person who intends to obtain approval for the establishment of a business association pursuant to Article 30 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for approval of the establishment of a business association for end-of-life vehicle recycling (including electronic documents) in the form of Annex No. 11, attached with documents (including electronic documents) containing the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended Dec. 31, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 기후에너지환경부장관은 제1항에 따라 사업자단체의 설립인가신청을 받은 때에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 검토하여 적합한 경우 인가하여야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment receives an application for approval of the establishment of a business association pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall review the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs and grant approval if deemed appropriate. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 목적과 사업이 타당하고 실현 가능한지 여부
rows.text_en: 1. Whether the purpose and project are valid and feasible

rows.source_ko: 2. 재활용사업을 지속적으로 수행할 수 있도록 적정한 조직과 회원을 확보하고 있는지 여부
rows.text_en: 2. Whether an appropriate organization and members are secured to continuously carry out the recycling business

rows.source_ko: 3. 재활용사업을 지속적으로 수행할 수 있는 재정능력을 갖추고 있는지 여부
rows.text_en: 3. Whether it possesses the financial capacity to continuously carry out the recycling business

rows.source_ko: 4. 다른 재활용단체 등과의 명칭이 구별되는지 여부
rows.text_en: 4. Whether the name is distinguishable from other recycling organizations, etc.

rows.source_ko: ③ 기후에너지환경부장관은 제1항에 따라 사업자단체 설립인가신청을 받으면 특별한 사유가 있는 경우 외에는 30일 이내에 제2항에 따라 검토하여 인가 여부를 결정하고 서면으로 신청인에게 알려야 한다. 이 경우 인가를 할 때에는 별지 제12호서식의 폐자동차재활용사업자단체 설립인가증을 신청인에게 발급하고 별지 제13호서식의 폐자동차재활용사업자단체 설립인가대장에 필요한 사항을 기록하여야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application for approval of the establishment of a business association pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall, except where there are special circumstances, review the application pursuant to Paragraph 2 within 30 days, decide whether to grant approval, and notify the applicant in writing. In this case, when granting approval, the Minister shall issue a Certificate of Approval for the Establishment of a Waste-and-End Vehicle Recycling Business Association in the form of Annex 12 to the applicant and record the necessary matters in the Register of Approval for the Establishment of a Waste-and-End Vehicle Recycling Business Association in the form of Annex 13. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 기후에너지환경부장관은 제2항에 따른 폐자동차재활용사업자단체의 설립인가의 검토를 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 신청인에게 기간을 정하여 필요한 서류를 제출하게 하거나 설명을 요구할 수 있다. 이 경우 그에 걸리는 기간은 제3항의 기간에 산입되지 아니한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ If the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems it necessary to review the approval of the establishment of an end-of-life vehicle recycling business association pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister may require the applicant to submit necessary documents or provide explanations within a specified period. In this case, the period required for such action shall not be included in the period under Paragraph 3. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제30조제3항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The terms “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 명칭
rows.text_en: 2. Name

rows.source_ko: 3. 사무소 소재지
rows.text_en: 3. Location of the office

rows.source_ko: 4. 자체 재활용시설의 내용(자체 재활용시설을 가지고 있는 사업자단체만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Details of in-house recycling facilities (Applicable only to business associations with in-house recycling facilities)

rows.source_ko: 제14조(폐자동차 재활용결과보고서 등) 자동차해체재활용업자 등이 법 제31조 및 영 제29조에 따라 제출해야 하는 재활용결과보고서 등의 서식은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2019. 6. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Report on Recycling Results of End-of-Life Vehicles, etc.) The forms for the recycling results report, etc. , that automobile dismantling and recycling business operators, etc. are required to submit pursuant to Article 31 of the Act and Article 29 of the Enforcement Decree are as follows: <Amended June 12, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 자동차해체재활용업자의 폐자동차 재활용결과보고서 : 별지 제14호서식
rows.text_en: 1. Report on End-of-Life Vehicle Recycling Results by an Automobile Dismantling and Recycling Business Operator: Attached Form No. 14

rows.source_ko: 2. 파쇄재활용업자의 재활용결과보고서 : 별지 제15호서식
rows.text_en: 2. Report on Recycling Results by Crushing and Recycling Operator: Attached Form No. 15

rows.source_ko: 3. 파쇄잔재물재활용업자의 재활용과 에너지 회수실적 : 별지 제16호서식
rows.text_en: 3. Recycling and Energy Recovery Performance of Crushed Residue Recyclers: Attached Form No. 16

rows.source_ko: 4. 폐가스류처리업자의 기후ㆍ생태계 변화유발물질의 재활용과 처리실적 : 별지 제17호서식
rows.text_en: 4. Performance of Recycling and Treatment of Climate and Ecosystem Change-Inducing Substances by Waste Gas Treatment Operators: Attached Form No. 17

rows.source_ko: 제15조(폐자동차재활용업 및 폐가스류처리업 등록신청 등) ① 법 제32조제1항 또는 제32조의2제1항ㆍ제2항에 따라 폐자동차재활용업 또는 폐가스류처리업으로 등록하거나 등록을 변경하려는 자는 별지 제18호서식의 폐자동차재활용업 또는 폐가스류처리업 등록(변경등록, 변경신고)신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 공단에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Application for Registration of End-of-Life Vehicle Recycling Business and Waste Gas Treatment Business, etc.) ① Any person who intends to register or change the registration of an end-of-life vehicle recycling business or a waste gas treatment business pursuant to Article 32 , Paragraph 1 or Article 32-2 , Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Act shall submit to the Corporation the application for registration (change registration, change notification) of an end-of-life vehicle recycling business or a waste gas treatment business in the form of Annex 18 , attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents).

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업장의 위치도 및 평면도
rows.text_en: 1. Location map and floor plan of the workplace

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 별표 7의3에 따른 등록기준에 따른 시설 및 장비 명세서(해당 시설 및 장비를 갖추었음을 증명하는 서류를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Specification of facilities and equipment in accordance with the registration standards under Annex 7-3 of the Enforcement Decree (including documents proving that the relevant facilities and equipment have been provided)

rows.source_ko: 3. 시설설치 명세서 및 재활용ㆍ처리공정도
rows.text_en: 3. Facility Installation Specifications and Recycling and Treatment Process Flowchart

rows.source_ko: 4. 수집ㆍ운반ㆍ재활용ㆍ처리계획서 등 사업계획서
rows.text_en: 4. Business plan including collection, transportation, recycling, and treatment plans

rows.source_ko: 5. 재활용시설 운전계획서
rows.text_en: 5. Recycling Facility Operation Plan

rows.source_ko: 6. 변경등록ㆍ변경신고 사유를 확인할 수 있는 서류(변경등록ㆍ변경신고하려는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 6. Documents verifying the reason for the change registration or change notification (applicable only to cases of change registration or change notification)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 공단은 「전자정부법」 제36조제2항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 및 사업자등록증명을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Corporation shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (only applicable to corporations) and the Certificate of Business Registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 2 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the applicant must be required to attach the document.

rows.source_ko: ③ 공단은 법 제33조의2제1항에 따라 폐자동차재활용업 또는 폐가스류처리업 등록증을 발급할 경우에는 별지 제19호서식에 따라 발급하고, 그 내용(변경등록 및 변경신고 내용을 포함한다)을 별지 제20호서식의 폐자동차재활용업 또는 폐가스류처리업 등록(변경등록, 변경신고)대장에 기록ㆍ유지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the Corporation issues a certificate of registration for a waste vehicle recycling business or a waste gas treatment business pursuant to Article 33-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall issue it in accordance with Form No. 19 of the Attached Form, and record and maintain the details therein (including details of change registration and change notification) in the register of waste vehicle recycling business or waste gas treatment business (change registration, change notification) in Form No. 20 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly revised June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(폐자동차재활용업 및 폐가스류처리업 휴업ㆍ폐업ㆍ재개업의 신고) ① 법 제33조의3제1항에 따라 폐자동차재활용업 또는 폐가스류처리업의 휴업ㆍ폐업 또는 재개업 신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제20호의2서식의 폐자동차재활용업ㆍ폐가스류처리업 휴업ㆍ폐업ㆍ재개업 신고서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 공단에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Reporting of Suspension, Closure, or Resumption of End-of-Life Vehicle Recycling Business and Waste Gas Treatment Business) ①person who intends to report the suspension, closure, or resumption of an end-of-life vehicle recycling business or a waste gas treatment business pursuant to Article 33-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Corporation the Reporting of Suspension, Closure, or Resumption of End-of-Life Vehicle Recycling Business and Waste Gas Treatment Business in Form No. 20-2 of the Appendix, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 휴업ㆍ폐업의 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In case of temporary or permanent closure

rows.source_ko: 가. 폐자동차재활용업 또는 폐가스류처리업 등록증 원본
rows.text_en: a. Original registration certificate for end-of-life vehicle recycling business or waste gas treatment business

rows.source_ko: 나. 별지 제20호의3서식의 보관폐기물 처리계획서
rows.text_en: B. Storage Waste Disposal Plan ( Form No. 20-3)

rows.source_ko: 2. 재개업의 경우: 제15조제1항 각 호의 서류
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of resumption of business: Documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 15, Paragraph 1

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 공단은 그 내용과 법 제33조의3제2항에 따른 폐기물의 처리결과를 확인하여 관계 법령에 적합하면 휴업ㆍ폐업 또는 재개업 신고를 수리해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Corporation that receives an application under Paragraph 1 shall verify the contents thereof and the results of waste treatment pursuant to Article 33-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act , and if it complies with relevant laws and regulations, accept the report of suspension, closure, or resumption of business.
[Wholly revised June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(행정처분의 기준) ① 법 제34조제2항에 따른 행정처분의 기준은 별표 4와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions) ①The standards for administrative dispositions pursuant to Article 34, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 4 .

rows.source_ko: ② 기후에너지환경부장관은 위반사항의 내용으로 보아 그 위반 정도가 경미하거나 그 밖에 특별한 사유가 있다고 인정되는 경우에는 별표 4의 행정처분의 기준에도 불구하고 그 행정처분을 감경할 수 있다. 이 경우 감경량은 당초 처분기준의 2분의 1을 초과하지 아니하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding the standards for administrative dispositions in Annex 4 , the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may mitigate administrative dispositions if, considering the nature of the violation, the degree of violation is deemed minor or there are other special grounds. In such cases, the amount of reduction shall not exceed one-half of the original disposition standard. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(폐자동차재활용업자 및 폐가스류처리업자의 지위의 승계신고) 폐자동차재활용업자 또는 폐가스류처리업자의 지위를 승계한 자는 법 제35조제4항에 따라 별지 제21호서식의 폐자동차재활용업자 또는 폐가스류처리업자의 지위승계신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2012. 1. 3., 2013. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Report on Succession of Status of End-of-Life Vehicle Recycler and Waste Gas Treatment Business Operator) A person who has succeeded to the status of an end-of-life vehicle recycling business operator or a waste gas treatment business operatorin accordance with Article 35 , Paragraph 4 of the Act , submit a Report on Succession of Status of End-of-Life Vehicle Recycler or Waste Gas Treatment Business Operator in the Form of Annex 21 to the Corporation, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 3, 2012; Dec. 31, 2013; July 6, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 폐자동차재활용업 또는 폐가스류처리업 등록증 원본 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One original copy of the registration certificate for end-of-life vehicle recycling or waste gas treatment business

rows.source_ko: 2. 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents classified according to each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 양도ㆍ양수의 경우: 양도ㆍ양수계약서 사본 등 양도ㆍ양수를 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: a. In the case of transfer or assignment: Documents proving the transfer or assignment, such as a copy of the transfer or assignment agreement

rows.source_ko: 나. 상속의 경우: 「가족관계의 등록 등에 관한 법률」 제15조제1항제1호에 따른 가족관계증명서 등 상속인임을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: B. In the case of inheritance: Documents proving heirship, such as a family relationship certificate pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act on Registration of Family Relations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 다. 가목 및 나목 외의 경우: 해당 사유별로 영업자의 지위를 승계하였음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: C. Cases other than Subparagraphs A and B: Documents proving the succession of the business operator's status for each relevant reason
[Title amended Dec. 31, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제19조(재활용실적 등의 기록ㆍ보존) 영 제32조에 따라 전기ㆍ전자제품 재활용의무생산자, 전기ㆍ전자제품 판매업자 또는 자동차의 제조ㆍ수입업자 등이 기록ㆍ보존하여야 할 장부의 서식은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2012. 1. 3., 2013. 12. 31., 2019. 6. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Recording and Preservation of Recycling Performance, etc.) Pursuant to Article 32 of the Enforcement Decree, the forms of ledgers that obligated producers of electrical and electronic products, retailers of electrical and electronic products, or manufacturers and importers of automobiles, etc., are required to record and preserve are as follows: <Amended Jan. 3, 2012; Dec. 31, 2013; Jun. 12, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 재활용의무대상 전기ㆍ전자제품의 제조ㆍ수입관리대장 : 별지 제22호서식
rows.text_en: 1. Register of Manufacturing and Import Management of Electrical and Electronic Products Subject to Mandatory Recycling: Form No. 22

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 회수의무대상 전기ㆍ전자제품의 매입ㆍ판매관리대장 : 별지 제22호의2서식
rows.text_en: 1-2. Purchase and Sales Management Register for Electrical and Electronic Products Subject to Recall Obligation: Form No. 22-2

rows.source_ko: 2. 회수ㆍ재활용의무대상 전기ㆍ전자제품의 회수ㆍ재활용관리대장 : 별지 제23호서식
rows.text_en: 2. Ledger for the Management of Collection and Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products Subject to Mandatory Collection and Recycling: Form No. 23

rows.source_ko: 3. 재질ㆍ구조개선평가대장 : 별지 제24호서식
rows.text_en: 3. Material and Structural Improvement Evaluation Register: Form No. 24

rows.source_ko: 4. 폐자동차 인수ㆍ재활용관리대장 : 별지 제25호서식
rows.text_en: 4. Register of Management for Acquisition and Recycling of End-of-Life Vehicles: Form No. 25

rows.source_ko: 5. 폐자동차 파쇄ㆍ재활용관리대장 : 별지 제26호서식
rows.text_en: 5. End-of-life Vehicle Crushing and Recycling Management Register: Attached Form No. 26

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Submission of Recycling Obligation Fulfillment Plans)  Any recycling obligation fulfillment plan submitted pursuant to Article 15 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of Resource Conservation and Recycling prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed as a recycling obligation fulfillment plan submitted pursuant to Article 6.

rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Submission of Reports on the Results of Fulfillment of Recycling Obligations)  Reports on the results of fulfillment of recycling obligations submitted pursuant to Article 17 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of Resource Conservation and Recycling prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to be reports on the results of fulfillment of recycling obligations submitted pursuant to Article 8.

rows.source_ko: 제4조 (다른 법령과의 관계) 다른 법령에서 「자원의 절약과 재활용촉진에 관한 법률 시행규칙」의 규정(전기ㆍ전자제품의 경우에만 해당한다)을 인용한 경우에 이 규칙 가운데 그에 해당하는 규정이 있으면 그 종전의 규정을 갈음하여 이 규칙 또는 이 규칙의 해당 조항을 인용한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Relationship with Other Laws and Regulations)  Where other laws and regulations cite the provisions of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Promotion of Resource Conservation and Recycling (applicable only to electrical and electronic products), if there are corresponding provisions in these Rules, it shall be deemed that these Rules or the relevant provisions of these Rules have been cited in place of the former provisions.
